prior_matrix.finding: FRED identifies PERMIT as a monthly, seasonally adjusted annual-rate series in thousands of units sourced from the Census Bureau and HUD, requests citation, and warns that graph data are subject to revision.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Present-vintage permit levels are not original release vintages, and year-over-year growth need not predict BTC.

prior_matrix.finding: The program reports new privately owned housing units authorized by permits, started, under construction and completed using the Building Permits Survey and Survey of Construction.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Permits are a housing and credit-sensitive activity measure; they do not uniquely identify global liquidity or speculative risk appetite.

prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: PERMIT is a quantity-based prospective construction measure with a frozen year-over-year relation, not a sentiment threshold, component or rescue of UMCSENT.
